text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and I decide to go shopping together.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry, I was just humming along with the radio. I really love this song!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You know those poppy, upbeat songs that all the kids are into? I just adore that stuff! ♪

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text: Whew, that one really takes me back! Let's continue our trip down memory lane with more golden oldies!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: N-no way! That was… a classic? But I was really grooving with it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky's mood drops like a rock.
